acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC-8a: `IFilterSlotRepository.SaveAsync` XML doc includes an `<exception cref="ArgumentException">` entry for null/empty Name or Expression.
AC-8d: No other files are modified by this WP.

summary: AC-8a: Added <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"> and <exception cref="ArgumentException"> XML doc tags to IFilterSlotRepository.SaveAsync in IFilterSlotRepository.cs. Removed the outdated 'Null property guard' remarks paragraph that incorrectly stated Name/Expression were not validated — they are now validated by DapperFilterSlotRepository (WP-007).
AC-8b: Added IRelayCommand ClearSelectionCommand entry to the FiltersManagerViewModel section of api-surface.md, with comment noting it sets SelectedSlot = null and is wired to the 'New' button.

AC-8c: Replaced the stale '// Note: slot.Name and slot.Expression are not validated before SQL execution; null values yield a DB-level exception.' comment in api-surface.md with '// Throws ArgumentException when slot.Name or slot.Expression is null or empty (validated before SQL executes).'
AC-8d: Only IFilterSlotRepository.cs and docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md were modified.

comments.note: IFilterSlotRepository.cs: The old 'Null property guard' remarks paragraph was removed entirely since it described a pre-WP-007 limitation that no longer applies. The <exception> tags now serve as the canonical contract documentation for callers.
